verdicts.reason: A is unusable. All of the text has come loose from its white card and now sits directly on the busy fresco, where it can't be read. The card is an empty white box in the lower half, and the cross ornament has dropped to the bottom-left corner on top of the icons. B keeps the card, cross, headline, scripture and address together as in the original, and the hierarchy reads clearly. Its card nearly fills the width with tight side margins, and the ornate top edge crowds the canvas top, but these are only polish issues.
